label: monk2-s7
summary: This MONK-2 network computes the target rule (yes when exactly two of the six attributes take their first value) as a band on the count of first values, with three parts added on the logit scale. A direct penalty lowers the score for each first value, so three or more first values give a no (share of cells predicted yes: 0%, 0%, 0% and 0% for three to six). Unit 389 registers a4:1 or a5:1. A veto unit, 288, fires when fewer than two attributes are at their first value (on for 89 of the 89 such training rows) and pushes the score far down. Enumerating all 432 input combinations, the model agrees with the rule on 428. The 4 misses are the cells whose two first values are a2 and a5, where the veto leaks and the prediction is 28%; 3 of them are training rows. Switching off the veto, unit 389 or the direct penalty takes the training AUC from 1.000 to 0.616, 0.699 and 0.814. The a4:2 branch (unit 2443) is dead, and seven one-hot inputs have no edges.
